description: Clone a GitHub repository from a dialog: the repositories of the gh account of each machine, with owner chips and a fuzzy search, cloned in a visible terminal into the folder that you set for each machine and owner. Needs gh.

settings.label: Shortcut
settings.hint: Opens the GitHub Clone dialog. Saved in keys.json.

settings.label: List order
settings.hint: The order of the repositories when the search is empty. The selector in the dialog changes this too.

settings.label: Clone folders
settings.hint: The clone folder of each machine and the owner rules are in the dialog: click the gear at the top right.
